name: 10_transfer_window
description: Admin enables windows after the first lockups end; a quarterly window clears 35 units at 125 USDC supply-limited (bids above p* fill, the single bid at p* takes the remainder first-come, the ask above p* gets its units back), buyers pay the 1% window fee, sellers' accrued payouts are settled before their balance changes; wrong proposals are rejected (not reverted); lockup, eligibility, one-order-per-wallet, wallet-cap (invalid order) and direct-transfer rejections.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.
